description.value: Pizza 64 is a Canadian pizza chain that has been operating since 2010, with over 20 locations across British Columbia including this Kamloops outpost. The chain emphasizes fresh-made dough and sauce at each location, and offers a broad menu spanning specialty, signature, and gourmet pizzas alongside wings, pasta, and sides. For a touring cyclist rolling into Kamloops, it's a reliable spot for a filling hot meal with online ordering available for quick pickup.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Pizza 64 is a real, active Canadian pizza chain with 20+ BC locations and a fully functional online ordering system, establishing it as a genuine open business. No bike-specific amenities (rack, Wi-Fi, charging) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so all such fields default to null. Vegetarian options are confirmed by multiple meat-free menu items (Garden Fresh, Pesto Veggie, Passion of India/Shahi Paneer with paneer), and takeout is confirmed by the prominent 'Order Online' functionality central to the site.
concerns: No street address present in OSM record; the specific Kamloops location address could not be confirmed from the website content fetched (hours-and-locations subpage loaded as the franchising application page, possibly a site navigation issue).
Phone number in OSM is not confirmed by website content — the site does not list per-location phone numbers in the fetched pages.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating pizza restaurant chain with confirmed Kamloops presence; a practical meal stop for touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Multiple vegetarian pizzas on menu: Garden Fresh (no meat), Pesto Veggie (no meat), Passion of India and Shahi Paneer (Tandoori Paneer, no meat). No confirmed vegan or GF options
